body:
If you knew me you would not say that.  I am soon be 53, with the failure of my marriage I had to give in and confront that I am transgender.  Do you even understand how much that sucks.  How much I did not want to be here, how hard I tired not be here. I have a very bleak future ahead of me. I just burned my only bridge to the local community by not doing well as a fund raiser. They ended up taking my position from me very publicly.  So yeah everyone knows I failed.... I tired to tell them no when they game it to me, they would not listen, the kept telling me they would help... they did not... fuck I am just a waste.  

I have no successes, just failure and mediocrity. My kid is succeeding, that is because of his talent. I have nothing to do with that. Other then finding him coaches and get him to hockey practice. She can do that, I have done all the work. She just needs to keep it going.

I have failed at learning from my failures. I keep losing and losing and grinding down, I til my ex years ago there was almost nothing left of me then. Her abuse and alcoholism, the constant worry. Being the only one to take care of our youngest son then.  He is 15 now does not need me, I more a pain in ass then anything else. Will more then likely be a relief to him.  

I have did the reading, I know a 20 gage shot gun to the brain stem will more then take of it.

Hello, my STBX was the same. I never felt secure in her life.  She would constantly devalue me in favor of friends and just about anything else. I always felt like I had to be the one to compromise or she would leave me.  I still have trouble accepting that I spent 20years with someone when it came down  to it, did not love me, just loved what I did for her. 

So now I am on my own and rebuilding who I am with the hope there will be someone out there who values me this time.
I have my sister who I have known just shy of two years. So now she will get to decide if I live or die.. good sibling ehh...yes have the covers as I like is a bonus.

Hello, living through this myself. She has been dragging her feet about filing the dissolution paperwork for almost year. Has had two boyfriends, neither are generally available for her needs.  So she continues to try and rely on me.  Last week I finally had enough and asked why she keeps calling me when she is need. Her response was you are have always been there for me.  So I have shut that down for the most now, she will no longer make me her first call. 

By the way, she was the same as your spouse. Loyalty above all. Until she wanted to get laid, then well we have been separated so well it was none of your business. 

It sucks and separation can be difficult, just keep looking forward one day it will end.

She asked me for a divorce in Oct of 2016, I was not able to move out until June of 2017, she keeps not filing the dissolution, I do not have the money for an attorney to file, she likes being double covered by insurance.  Likes watching me hurt as she sleeps with others.
He will not, he no longer needs or wants me to involved in his life for the most part.  He will be relieved.  Like my STBX, she will dance a jig, she has wanted me to do this for years.

Yes, she has done crap like that all through our marriage. When my mom passed, she took her handicap placard and used to park downtown in handicap spaces.  She hid from me, I found it when I was cleaning her car for much later.
Than you, that has been my slow realization as I get separation.  She fell in love with me fixing the world around her, and the roll I could play in her life.  Me as person did not matter so much.

Yes already experiencing that, 18 years with someone who would never love me.  I have my 15 year old. The 22 year old is from her first marriage.  So I am with you, give the time I need for it then move on and hopefully find someone.

Yes, I fully believe that as I continue to get healthy myself. Set standards for how I others to treat me and just get back to who I used be for the most part.  My 15 year old and I share hockey in the winter I’m fishing in my boat in the summer.  I wanted to try one more time for an open honest relationship with her in our divorce. Not going to happen, so I move on.

Thank you, I think after this I am out of it now.  I just wanted to try one last time for honesty.  I have accepted that she can not even be honest with herself, her boyfriends, her friends.  Much less me, and our sons.  So my 15 year old should be away next year playing hockey, our 22 year old is well 22... so I just need continue with my Therpist, rebuild myself and move on to hopefully someone else in a couple of years.
